title: Adversarial pattern templates
description: Test-fixture catalog of text fragments designed to probe detector false-positive behavior and classifier keyword-stuffing resistance. Records in the column_header_label category additionally carry a bbox_context array describing header/data row layout.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

patterns.description: Ordered list of pattern records. Order is stable across rebuilds at a given seed.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the artifact.

category.description: Which kind of adversarial pressure this record applies.

expected_detector.description: Which detector this fragment is shaped to provoke, or 'none' for classifier-only fragments.

expected_outcome.description: Desired detector behavior: redact (act on it), suppress (explicitly do not redact despite shape match), or flag (route to review).

source_plan_ref.description: A short provenance description of the fragment — what detector shape it exercises and why it must be suppressed or flagged.

bbox_context.description: Optional layout context for column_header_label records. Each item describes a header-row or data-row bounding box in PDF points relative to the page top-left. Present only on column_header_label entries.
